content.text: The Refresh Materialized Lake View activity in Fabric Data Factory pipelines in Fabric Data Factory pipelines lets you refresh materialized lake views on demand or on a schedule within your pipeline orchestration. Event-driven refresh for materialized lake views triggers dependent materialized lake view refreshes when OneLake file events or pipeline and notebook job events occur. For more information, see Schedule a materialized lake view refresh.
